notes.title: Hotfix 2
notes.content: [p]Fixed the following bugs:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where items would float in the air.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the monster would not run away from you when using your soundblast.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the monster would scream at spawn.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed player facing the wrong direction at spawn.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone, we did some further testing ourselves are found a couple bugs that snuck past us during development, so here's a hotfix addressing them:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the monster would run away screaming and disappear.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the monster would spin around indefinitely.[/p][/*][/list][p]If you find any bugs yourself please feel free to report them in the discussions.[/p]

notes.title: Major Content Update
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]Hope you had a great summer! We've been hard at work to bring you this major content update featuring all three levels, an audio rework, Steam achievements, and a fully supported VR mode! A lot of work has gone into this outside of regular school hours, so we hope you will enjoy this update as much as we enjoyed making it, and let us know any feedback or bugs you may find![/p][p][/p][p]That is all from us at Silent Labs, good luck on your mission rescuing Isabella from the facility![/p][previewyoutube="ck3DD7UUqNA;full"][/previewyoutube]
